question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.name AS region_name,
        ws.name AS sales_rep_name,
        COUNT(wo.id) AS order_count,
        SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wo.account_id = wa.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps ws ON wa.sales_rep_id = ws.id
    JOIN web_region wr ON ws.region_id = wr.id
    GROUP BY wr.name, ws.name
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        SUM(order_count) AS num_orders,
        SUM(total_sales) AS total_region_sales
    FROM region_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        sales_rep_name,
        total_sales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rnk
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    rt.region_name,
    CAST(rt.num_orders AS INTEGER) AS num_orders,
    ROUND(rt.total_region_sales, 2) AS total_region_sales,
    tr.sales_rep_name AS top_sales_rep,
    ROUND(tr.total_sales, 2) AS top_sales_rep_amount
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN top_reps tr ON rt.region_name = tr.region_name
WHERE tr.rnk = 1
ORDER BY rt.region_name

WITH region_sales AS (

        wr.name AS region_name,
        ws.name AS sales_rep_name,
        COUNT(wo.id) AS order_count,
        SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wo.account_id = wa.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps ws ON wa.sales_rep_id = ws.id
    JOIN web_region wr ON ws.region_id = wr.id
    GROUP BY wr.name, ws.name
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        SUM(order_count) AS num_orders,
        SUM(total_sales) AS total_region_sales
    FROM region_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        sales_rep_name,
        total_sales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rnk
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    rt.region_name,
    CAST(rt.num_orders AS INTEGER) AS num_orders,
    ROUND(rt.total_region_sales, 2) AS total_region_sales,
    tr.sales_rep_name AS top_sales_rep,
    ROUND(tr.total_sales, 2) AS top_sales_rep_amount
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN top_reps tr ON rt.region_name = tr.region_name
